name: Hrudayangam Mehta
headline: PhD student in Computer Science
summary: I am a PhD student in Computer Science at Binghamton University, advised by Jeremy Blackburn, and a research assistant in the iDRAMA Lab. I work on vision-language model (VLM) alignment and preference optimization, and explore VLMs' video-annotation capabilities for computational social science research on social media. My published research covers language-model evaluation, vision-language reasoning, and human-robot interaction.
anthology_summary: PhD researcher in the iDRAMA Lab at Binghamton University, advised by Jeremy Blackburn. Current work focuses on VLM alignment, preference optimization, and VLM-based annotation of social-media videos for computational social science. Published research examines policy-guided classification, spatial reasoning, and dialogue task specification.
